answer_1.quote: We evaluate Selective Context on four tasks: Original Context Reconstruction, Summarisation, Question Answering (QA), and Conversation.
answer_1.outputs: Summaries, question answers, reconstructed contexts, and conversation responses

answer_2.quote: We employ four metrics to assess the performance of our models on the tasks: BLEU, ME-TEOR, ROUGE, and BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: We asked three college students to evaluate 1150 generated summaries from llama and vicuna (about 55 per model and ratio) and record whether they accept the generation as a reasonable summary.
answer_4.guideline: record whether they accept the generation as a reasonable summary
